findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "preview" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_ad · Public sink: preview_ad · Destructive: preview_ad, get_ad_formats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_ad · Public sink: preview_ad · Destructive: preview_ad, get_ad_formats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "preview_ad" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
